phase_name: Strict-mode migration batch A (highest-risk state mutators)

objectives.note: Found and fixed 2 -e-hostile VAR=$(cmd) assignments (dry-run and real transform branches) that would have silently short-circuited past the documented exit-3 error message under -e. Fixed via the standard `VAR=$(cmd) || status=$?` guard. Verified with a live mktemp-fixture exercise (valid write, dry-run valid, dry-run invalid filter exit 3, real invalid filter exit 3 with file left untouched) plus test-state-write-concurrency.sh (9/9) and test-state-write-regen-timing.sh (3/3), both green. Committed separately (task 988 phase 6.1).

Full -e-hostility audit of all 1644 lines. Found three hazard classes: (1) ~50 bare `VAR=$(jq/ps/stat/cat/date/find ...)` command-substitution assignments with no explicit `||` guard; (2) 4 bare non-assignment statements whose failure was tolerated (`mkdir -p` x2, `cat > tmp_file`, `rm -f`/`rm -rf` x2); (3) a distinct and easy-to-miss `[ cond ] && action` bare-statement class (e.g. `[ -n "$x" ] && echo ... >&2`, `[ cond ] && continue`, `[ "$LOADED" = true ] && return 0`) that is `-e`-hostile whenever the CONDITION is false (the common case), not just when the guarded action fails -- this class was not called out by name in the plan and is worth flagging for the remaining Phase 6/7 files. Also found and fixed one true `VAR=$(cmd); status=$?` anti-pattern in cmd_acquire_retry (captured_stderr/rc), converted to the sanctioned `if VAR=$(cmd); then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi` idiom. Fixed the two heaviest-reused leaf helpers (read_holder_field, session_registry_dir) at their single definition site so every call site inherited the fix, rather than guarding each of their ~15 call sites individually. Verified via 27/27 run-all.sh (one pre-existing, documented-unrelated flaky failure in test-claude-refresh-matcher.sh reproduced identically both before and after this file's changes -- confirmed not a regression) plus an extensive live mktemp-fixture exercise covering every subcommand and every documented exit code: acquire (fresh/same-session-reentry/refuse/stale-override), acquire-retry (budget exhaustion), heartbeat, release (wrong-session warn, correct-session), check (free/held-fresh/held-stale), reap (dry-run, corrupt-holder skip, real reap), session-register/session-list/session-heartbeat/session-reap/session-release, scope-acquire/scope-release, commit-acquire/commit-release, and init-marker (fresh create + already-exists path). One pre-existing, zero-caller behavior quirk found in cmd_init_marker (a second call after a first successful call silently overwrites rather than returning 1, since init_dir is no longer held) -- confirmed present byte-for-byte in the pre-migration committed version via git diff, so NOT introduced by this migration; left unfixed as out of scope (init-marker has no live callers anywhere in agent-system/extensions/**) and flagged here as a residual finding for a future task.
